question: What supreme attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation combine as a great accomplishment
This accomplishment relates to the yoginīs
One may become dear to the yoginīs
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
